goals.name: Ski season prep
goals.notes: Be ready for the first week on snow: stronger quads and posterior chain, steadier single-leg balance, and an aerobic base that survives a full day on the hill.

plans.name: Pre-season base
plans.notes: Four to five sessions a week. Two lower-body lifts, one balance day, one easy run, one longer run. Friday 21 Aug was a travel day and is missing on purpose.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Main squat day. Add load when all five sets are solid.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Conversational. Leave Monday's legs alone.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Slow eccentrics. The left side sets the load.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Hinge and hips. Stop nordics if a hamstring feels sharp.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Steady effort. Take a hill if the route has one.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: First squat day of the block. Kept a rep in reserve.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Easy out-and-back. Conversational the whole way.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Left side is the limiter on split squats.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Hip thrust lockout was the weak point.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Steady, not a race. Walked the steepest minute.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Bar speed was better than last week.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Flat route. Heart rate stayed down.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Slowed the eccentric. Less knee cave.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Deadlift from the floor felt heavier than the warm-up suggested.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Added a small hill at the end.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Knees felt fine. Last set of squats was the hard one.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Short hills, still easy.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Step-downs are humbling. Held the rail less.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Ten kilometres continuous. Fuelled with water only.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Lunges a bit wobbly. Slowed them down.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Legs heavy from Monday. Kept the pace honest.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Single-leg RDL balance improving if I stare at the floor less.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Nordics are short. Stopped before the hamstring felt sharp.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Legs turned over fine after yesterday's hinge work.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Solid five across. Quads will feel this tomorrow.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Cooler morning. Felt smooth.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Added a pause at the bottom of the split squat.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Hinge pattern cleaner than the start of August.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Longer loop. Kept the same effort, not the same pace on climbs.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Repeated the squat weight. Depth was the goal, not the plates.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: A bit flat. Cut the effort rather than the distance.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Left side still wobbles, but I finished every rep.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Side plank time is up. Hips still drop a little on the left.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Hillier route, more like a ski day than a tempo.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Moved the squat up again. Bracing felt tighter.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: River path. Could have talked in full sentences.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: No rail on the step-downs today.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Deadlift reps were smooth. Left a little in the tank.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Last three kilometres were the point of the session.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Easy to rush the Romanian deadlift. Stayed long on the way down.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Same loop as last week, a little quicker without pushing.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Split squats felt even for the first time.

sessions.title: Posterior chain
sessions.notes: Strong hip thrust day. This is the ski posterior chain.

sessions.title: Long run
sessions.notes: Fourteen kilometres, mostly relaxed. Climb at the finish.

sessions.title: Lower body
sessions.notes: Best squat day of the block so far.

sessions.title: Easy run
sessions.notes: Easy eight. Ready for Friday.

sessions.title: Balance
sessions.notes: Quiet session. Balance work is starting to look like strength.
